 RESOURCES  / 
 CASE STUDIES  / 
 KYRO BUILDERS
“We’re saving a couple hundred thousand dollars a year by covering our tails, by having documented evidence.”
Scaling a business through trust, quality, and partnership.
Industry
Roofing
Location
Chesapeake, VA
Employees
60
Customer Since
2022
Hours Saved Per Week
40
Labels Used
7,500
The Problem
Maintaining quality while away from the job site
Kyro Builders is a Virginia-based roofing, solar, and exterior company, co-founded by firefighters Kyle Billips and Robert Oliver in 2014. Each was taking on remodeling jobs during off days from the station to make some extra money, helping one another on each other’s jobs. 
But as word of the quality and reliability of the work spread from family to friends to friends of friends, they decided to form Kyro Builders and hired their fellow firefighters as some of their first employees. With their team’s unique background in emergency services, they knew firsthand the importance of documenting everything.
The team was capturing photos on their personal phones, but they kept running into issues with limited storage, broken phones, and employees not wanting to clutter their phones with work photos. They even tried handing out work phones, but more often than not, those didn’t make it out of the truck.
Because they lacked photo proof, they estimated that they were paying ​“a couple hundred thousand” dollars for preexisting damage—ripped hot tub covers, cracked driveways, and torn window screens — that homeowners may or may not have known were damaged before their team’s arrival. And since they are full-time firefighters, they needed a system in place to confidently rely on the team to manage jobs while they have limited access to their phones during their 24-hour shifts.
 “One of our sayings is, ​‘If you don’t document it, it never happened.’”
 Robert Oliver  —  co-founder, Kyro Builders
The Solution
Easy to implement field tools
Kyro Builders first heard about CompanyCam through their partnership with Atlas Roofing. They credit the trusting relationship they’ve built with the Atlas team as part of the reason for giving CompanyCam a go: “[Our Atlas rep] said, ​‘Hey, we’re partnering with CompanyCam. They’re great. If you’re not using it, you really need to check it out. It’s the best way to manage photos.”
After rolling it out, ​“the guys immediately loved it,” and management started getting more and more photos from the job site. As part of their process, their team walks the house twice, documenting every screen, shutter, and gutter before they even put on their tool belts.
These photos, along with time and date stamps, give them the confidence that everything is being documented, so that everyone can operate on the same page. Their documentation even helped them get a $40,000 lawsuit dismissed.
Consistent documentation also helps with conversations around change orders. As roofing jobs progress, their team numbers damaged materials with spray paint, snaps a photo in CompanyCam, and explains why it’s being replaced. They then install the new decking, take another picture, and continue along. They then share these with customers to explain why they had additional line items on their invoice: ​“This conversation is a lot easier once people can see why. [Customers] appreciate that.”
 “It’s really solved a lot of the issues. And as a business owner, I no longer had to keep hearing the excuses as to why they weren’t doing what they’re supposed to be doing.”
 Robert Oliver  —  co-founder, Kyro Builders
Insights
Measurable time and money savings
The team has grown to over 60 employees and is completing 12 – 20 jobs per week. They’ve added departments that encompass a range of projects, including commercial and HOA projects, residential maintenance, and insurance work.
As they grow into their second decade in operation, the owners can focus on diversifying their business and staying ahead of the curve, rather than worrying about the fundamentals of having proper documentation or avoiding communication breakdowns due to missing photos. 
Between their CRM Acculynx and CompanyCam, they estimate that they save about three administrative roles because of how efficiently their team can run the business with these systems, giving the owners peace of mind that things are being taken care of while they’re on duty.
They are expanding their fleet, investing in equipment to produce some of their own building materials, and doubling down on training for installation and sales crews so that they can continue to be the leader in their market in providing a great product and experience that both their customers and employees can be proud of.
